lines.speaker: EXTRA
lines.text: You may begin.

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: SPEECH
graphics.subtitle: POETRY · RELIGIOUS READING · INTERPRETATION
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: In speech, the clock starts the second the judge says, "You may begin." Let's get you ready for that moment.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for speech.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Poetry is any poem. Funny, religious or dramatic. If it's a poem, it goes here, and only here.

graphics.title: 3 CATEGORIES
graphics.subtitle: POETRY · RELIGIOUS READING · HUMOROUS OR DRAMATIC
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Religious Reading is a persuasive or inspiring piece that someone else wrote. Like a speech, an essay or an editorial.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: It needs a spiritual application that mentions God or Christ.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Then there's Humorous or Dramatic Interpretation. You take a scene from a play or a story and bring it to life.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Humorous is funny. Dramatic is serious. And if it has a spiritual application, it goes in Religious Reading instead.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Each school can enter three Elementary, two Junior High and three Senior High students per category.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And whatever you pick, memorize it.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic graphic

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Elementary, you get a minute and a half to five minutes.

graphics.title: TIME LIMITS
graphics.subtitle: ELEM 1:30–5 · JR HIGH 3–8 · SR HIGH 4–10
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title slides up 40 px with ease-out (12 frames), subtitle fades in 6 frames later

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Junior High, three to eight minutes. Senior High, four to ten.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 5: Graphic: three timers

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Come in under the minimum, and you lose ten points.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Thirty seconds before your time's up, a judge holds up a sign.

shots.framing: B-roll: typed copies handed to judges
shots.camera: Pages fan out one by one from a stack

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Before you start, hand the judges three typed copies of your piece and three judging sheets.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: B-roll: typed copies handed to judges

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Proofread those copies. The typing has to be correct.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: typed copies handed to judges

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: The judge checks your name, your piece and the author. Then you hear, "You may begin." That's when timing starts.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 7: B-roll: typed copies handed to judges

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Start with the title and the author. Don't know who wrote it? Just say, "Author unknown."

graphics.title: ON THE DAY
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: You can add a short intro to set the mood, and quick transitions. But all of that together is one minute, max. And it counts toward your time.

graphics.title: ON THE DAY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You get one prop. No costumes, no script, no lights, no sound effects and no stage makeup.

graphics.title: ON THE DAY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Keep it in good taste and doctrinally sound.

graphics.title: ON THE DAY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And pick something new. Not last year's piece, and not one someone else from your school is doing this year.

graphics.title: ON THE DAY
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Pick it right. Memorize it. Watch the clock.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
